record_title: A skewness–kurtosis phase diagram for flat signed Gaussian-chaos maxima
limitations: The sharp theorem is for independent coordinates and flat common-magnitude spectra; general spectra or dependence may require additional spectral information. The two-term crossover assumes R/(log p)^(5/3) tends to infinity. The result concerns the chaos-to-Gaussian comparison rather than the finite-sample U-statistic-to-chaos step. The full theorem text of Anderson–Coles–Hüsler (1997) was not inspected and remains an originality risk.
